goal: Close the two repo-scoped Trail-as-Product gaps the user asked for: (1) a .claude/ skill documenting the mint-log-seal-commit cycle procedure, parallel to create-plugin; (2) real pmcro-planner/pmcro-maker/pmcro-checker/pmcro-reflector plugins so cycles stop being hand-simulated by one agent playing all four roles.
name_rationale: Names the action a session takes when it loads it, parallel to create-plugin's naming; distinguishes it from the plugins/ product surface it documents.

steps.action: Scaffold plugins/pmcro-planner: plugin.json (+ .claude-plugin copy), agents/planner.md, skills/plan (SKILL.md + command/run/reject triad + references/README.md).
Scaffold plugins/pmcro-maker: plugin.json (+ .claude-plugin copy), agents/maker.md, skills/make (SKILL.md + command/run/reject triad + references/README.md), one-step-at-a-time contract.
Scaffold plugins/pmcro-checker: plugin.json (+ .claude-plugin copy), agents/checker.md, skills/check (SKILL.md + command/run/reject triad + references/README.md).

Scaffold plugins/pmcro-reflector: plugin.json (+ .claude-plugin copy), agents/reflector.md, skills/reflect-and-seed (SKILL.md + command/run/reject triad + references/README.md + a new schema.queue-item.asset.json for filed next_seed items, since queue items are a structured artifact too under Trail-as-Product).
Author .claude/skills/run-pmcro-cycle/SKILL.md sequencing the five real plugins and restating the incremental-logging, single-owner-per-file, seal-only-via-reflector rules.
Update root README.md (new plugins, .claude/ tooling section, queue-item schema pointer) and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (four new plugin entries) to match the new repo shape.
Update .claude/skills/create-plugin/SKILL.md's known-good-reference list to include the four new plugins.
Build and verify all six plugin zips (existing two plus four new) via New-PluginZip.ps1; validate the four new plugins with claude plugin validate.

Confirm every new plugin follows the same conventions already fixed the hard way this session: .claude-plugin/plugin.json present, dotless agent basenames, forward-slash zip paths, no drive-letter paths anywhere.

success_criteria: All four new plugins validate cleanly via claude plugin validate
All six plugin zips (rebuilt) contain only forward-slash paths, a .claude-plugin/plugin.json at the root, and — where present — a dotless agent basename
run-pmcro-cycle SKILL.md exists and correctly sequences the five real commands
README.md and marketplace.json reflect the six-plugin repo shape, not the original two
No drive-letter or other host-specific paths introduced anywhere in this cycle's new content
out_of_scope: Actually wiring these five plugins to invoke each other automatically (no scheduler exists in this repo; a session still runs a cycle by following each role's run.*.asset.md in turn)
The portable account-level Trail-as-Product skill (handled via propose_skills, not a repo file, not owned by any phase file here)
A .agents/ authoring surface or laws/policies/capabilities layers
